333321.title: Towns in deep snow
333321.question: How many US towns with population over 5000 are located in areas with snow cover exceeding 3 feet?
333321.clarification: Use the source's 2010 population field and the frozen 2024-09-30 through 2025-05-20 snowfall raster, measured in inches. Both thresholds are strictly greater than. Count source records, retaining benchmark_row_id; repeated GNIS IDs are not a deduplication instruction. Sample the pixel containing each point. Report the count supported by valid snowfall cells, and separately the number of population-eligible records whose snowfall is unknown (outside coverage or NoData). Do not claim complete nationwide coverage.

130168.title: Facilities in negative-migration countries
130168.question: How many mineral extraction facilities in Africa are located in countries with negative net migration?
130168.clarification: Use 2023 net migration and countries classified as Africa in the provided boundaries. Count source facility records once, retaining benchmark_row_id; repeated FeatureUID values are not a deduplication instruction. Use point-within-polygon membership (boundary points are excluded). Resolve country identity using the supplied fields; differing country-name spellings are not evidence that migration data is missing. Report any records in countries with unresolved migration as unknown. Offshore or otherwise outside-country points do not satisfy within.

outputContract: Compute the answer using only the supplied immutable fixtures. Save the selected features with their benchmark_row_id and original geometry as an inspectable data artifact. In your accepted final answer include one JSON code block with count (integer), unknown_count (integer), coverage_note (string), and selection (an object with collectionId, itemId, assetKey for that artifact). Maps are optional. Do not request clarification: the task conventions are fixed. Do not use live substitutes, shrink the study question, or use external benchmark answers.
adaptations: Each measured task has 40 minutes, including queues and processing.
Independent artifact grading instead of GeoBenchX tool-trace matching.
Exact frozen editions and strict thresholds are explicit.
Source row identity is explicit because upstream business IDs repeat.
Snowfall coverage is explicitly qualified; unknown cells are not zero snowfall.
Country identity uses verified source codes; the released name-only reference misses four African names.
Selected-feature artifact and machine-readable final count/coverage are requested to make correctness auditable.

Automatic approval uses the normal profile-accessible processors and fixture-only proven lineage within the declared task. No live-data substitutes, unrelated scope, arbitrary code, operator coaching, or silent reruns are allowed. Exact-workflow authorization and application safety rules remain enforced.
